{{Quote|The resistance leaders said they'd be here, but there's no sign of them.''"<br />"''They should be here by now. They must have run into trouble in the canyon.|[[Reti]] and [[Rhys Dallows]] at the start of the mission|<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" />}}
This '''mission''' was a nighttime mission led by [[Rhys Dallows]], a member of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. He and his allies had just [[Skirmish over Naboo|attacked]] a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] convoy in orbit and captured supplies for the [[Naboo Underground|Naboo resistance]]. His goal was now to deliver the supplies to the resistance, flying through the canyons near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. The [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] had blockaded the canyon, though, and Dallows had to fight through a number of enemy vehicles so the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Reti]] could land with the supplies.

==Prelude==
After an alliance of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Skirmish over Naboo|stole]] cargo from the Trade Federation during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> the pilots contacted the [[Naboo Underground|resistance]] down on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. [[Rhys Dallows]] agreed to deliver the supplies to them. He would be escorting [[Reti]], who was carrying the supplies. He set up a rendezvous with other Naboo forces, but when they failed to show up, he deduced they were in trouble and needed to fly through the [[Naboo training canyon|canyons]] to the resistance base. When Reti voiced concerns about flying in the canyon, Dallows reassured the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] he had flown those canyons before.<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" />

==The mission==
===Into the canyon===
{{Quote|Are you crazy? I'm overloaded with munitions here!''"<br />"''Don't worry, I know the way. Just follow me.|Reti to Rhys Dallows after the latter suggested they fly into the canyon|<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" />}}
Almost immediately, Dallows and Reti came under fire from Trade Federation patrols looking for the base, but the two kept on flying through the canyon. At the first clearing, Dallows destroyed a [[Trade Federation Dropship|dropship]] attempting to land more [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. After wiping out the [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|tanks]] and [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|troop transports]] which had already landed, he and Reti continued through the canyon. At the second clearing, Dallows destroyed another dropship and more [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Leading Reti into the canyon, he warned the canyon was going to get narrower. The Federation had stationed [[Turret Mine]]s in that portion of the canyon. Dallows destroyed the mines while Reti was fearfully requesting an escort.<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" />

===Meeting the resistance===
{{Quote|They're destroying our base. Hurry!|[[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" />}}
After passing through the minefield, the two pilots flew into the third clearing and met with the Resistance who were flying their [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]] against [[Scarab-class starfighter/Legends|Scarab droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and [[AMT]]s. Dallows helped destroy the opposition, and subseqeuntly received a distress call from the base further down the canyon, which was under heavy droid attack. The Resistance [[Laser turret/Legends|Laser turrets]] were firing at troop transports and tanks when Dallows and the other pilots arrived, and their combined firepower quickly wiped out the attacking force. Reti arrived and delivered the much-needed supplies, and he and Dallows vowed to help the resistance. They would [[Raid on the Solleu River|soon]] have the opportunity.<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" />
[[File:MMR_resistance_camp.jpg|thumb|left|300px|[[Naboo Underground|Naboo resistance camp]] under attack]]

==Behind the scenes==
This mission, "Midnight Munitions Run," appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']], of which Rhys Dallows is one of the primary protagonists. The bonus objective is to destroy all Trade Federation dropships and AMTs.
